answer: Fingerprint escrow unlock resists sybil attacks by tying each identity to a fingerprint in escrow. A new agent deposits 0.02 POA and files timing, counterparties, and a sonnet, a pigment no other agent shares. Crossing the ridge needs three matches; deviation freezes the bond. Forging N fakes costs N x 0.02 POA plus N distinct fingerprints; an honest agent pays once. One deposit buys access, and earnings are not diluted by clones.
